latest_release.name: v0.9.42
latest_release.body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.42

Released on 2026-11-13.

Studio now says why a file cannot be saved when another program holds it open or it is read-only. Dragging and resizing a layer draw live over an opaque preview, local renders bring in only media, font, CSS and JS files from outside the project, and preparing fonts for large pages is faster.

## Features

- **Studio:** Drag and resize draw live on an opaque preview over its channel ([87c4a07dc99a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/87c4a07dc99a91e185c02a53090bdf941ff32db2), [#7646](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7646)).
- **Studio:** Layers panel and marquee read an opaque preview over its channel ([be67089a80b59](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be67089a80b59be945d84e09d400a4ece254daef), [#7639](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7639)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** Local renders bring in only media, font, CSS and JS from outside the project ([2c2b399bfa229](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c2b399bfa229d759d560aaf63e9717afed9805c), [#7647](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7647)).
- **Studio:** A file held open or read-only answers 423 or 403 with a reason, not 404 or 500 ([0bce3315e645e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0bce3315e645e513e10be271ad5bf415939a4147), [#7649](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7649)).
- **Deps:** Update dependency undici to v7.30.1 [security] ([d79e72c02479b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d79e72c02479b77195521d9a630702f7e0f53b00), [#6695](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6695)).
- **Studio:** Open the canvas context menu when a pointer move overtakes its lookup ([d208281091b1c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d208281091b1c00db1724a2ee3db0055955eb41b), [#7643](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7643)).

## Performance

- **Core:** The font step parses the page once for all its readers ([9f0a4edb439bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9f0a4edb439bbdc9782617a433b80d3f7f9dbe76), [#7650](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7650)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Adopters:** Add varg ([ff687fed9900e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff687fed9900ed6a531057f2ebbed7ad43e801c6), [#7640](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7640)).

## Internal

- **Deps:** Update happy-dom to ^21.0.4 ([d77731aab5ce6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d77731aab5ce68d03323edc4c527535095e732cc), [#7641](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7641)).
- **Skills:** Move the data-driven corpus fixture to zod 4 ([27af0ac8e178a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/27af0ac8e178ad34015fce4f7d4776434830d992), [#7642](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7642)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.41...v0.9.42
